description: S462 Q12 — a lambda created inside a narrowed scope may run later, so it does not inherit the narrowing of a reactive cell; the bare `@user.name` inside it is E-TYPE-046.
rationale: §42.3.5 (ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S462 "a", Q12): "a lambda / function expression created inside a narrowed scope does NOT inherit the narrowing of reactive cells — it re-tests"
